result.document_summary: Part 5 of 7 of a Newark, NJ code-publisher page covering Revised General Ordinances Title II, chapter 10: historic preservation commission powers, a UEZ commercial facade loan program, a South Ward homeowner rehabilitation loan program, and the Live Newark loan forgiveness program.
result.notes: This part contains only municipal economic-development, facade-improvement and homeowner rehabilitation loan programs and historic preservation administration. None of the text addresses rent increase limits, just-cause eviction, security deposits, application screening fees (the $50 fee is a facade-loan application fee, not a tenant screening fee), screening restrictions or algorithmic rent setting, so no rules are extracted.
